title: `icons`
description: An optional array of display icons on a tool definition, each with a source URL, MIME type and size list.
question: Does the tool's icon set reach the agent's tool definition?
notes: Neither adapter that reaches 2026-07-28 exposes a tool icon set, and neither retains one in metadata; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0: the agents package contains no reference to icons. FunctionTool keeps the MCP title only.
notes_by_num.4: Pydantic AI 2.40.0: pydantic_ai.mcp declares icons on its resource type only. ToolDefinition has no icon field, so tool icons are dropped.
notes_by_num.5: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Absent from the tool definition in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: Pydantic AI models icons for resources but not for tools, so the omission is specific to the tool definition rather than a gap in its MCP typing. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Icons are the one part of a tool definition aimed at a human rather than a model. A framework that drops them removes the server's only way to identify its tools visually in any UI built on top of the adapter.
